newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia plans to boost trade with Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia plans to boost trade with Latin America.

text.p: Indonesian Trade and Industry Minister Tunky Ariwibowo said the country planned to boost trade with Latin American nations, especially with Mexico.
"Our trade with Latin American countries is still low. We should increase our role there, because there is big potential," Ariwibowo told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
Ariwibowo visited Argentina, Brazil and Mexico earlier this month.
"I found that many of our goods were entering Latin American markets through the United States. We should find ways to boost direct trade, especially with Mexico," Ariwibowo said.
"Mexico can become our bridge to market our goods to other Latin American countries," he said.
